name: GitHub
description: GitHub agent tools over a platform-owned GitHub App installation credential. Structured issue and pull-request operations with no agent-visible token.

configSchema.description: GitHub App id used as the JWT issuer when minting an installation token.
Installation id whose scoped access token is minted.
Filesystem path to the GitHub App PEM private key.
API base address. Override for GitHub Enterprise Server.
Seconds before the reported expiry at which a cached token is refreshed.
Default 'owner/repo' used when a tool call omits the repository argument.
Human-readable label for the acting GitHub identity, reported in write results.
Page size used when a list tool call does not specify one.
Upper bound on a list page. A larger request is clamped and the clamp is reported in the result.
